businesses.business: performance nutrition and sports nutrition products

offering_description.value: Glanbia is an Ireland-based global nutrition company. It makes and sells sports and performance nutrition products (protein powders, bars, ready-to-drink shakes) to consumers, and ingredient and nutrition solutions (dairy and whey proteins, vitamin and mineral premixes) to food, beverage and supplement manufacturers.

primary_products.value: sports nutrition protein powders; protein bars and ready-to-drink shakes; whey and dairy protein ingredients; vitamin and mineral premixes; cheese

primary_services.value: custom nutrient premix formulation; contract nutrition solutions for food and supplement manufacturers

customer_segment.value: B2C: health and fitness consumers buying sports nutrition and lifestyle products, including online; B2B: retailers, food, beverage, supplement and pharmaceutical manufacturers, and infant and clinical nutrition brands

end_markets.value: sports nutrition; health and wellness; food and beverage manufacturing; dietary supplements; infant and clinical nutrition

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded nutrition products, dairy proteins, cheese and ingredient premixes sold to retailers, consumers and manufacturers; service fees: custom formulation and contract solutions for manufacturers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns sports nutrition brands, sold to consumers and retailers, with some co-manufacturing; OEM / manufacturer: processes milk, whey and nutrients into proteins, cheese and premixes for food manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America (largest market), Europe including Ireland and UK, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: branded sports nutrition, dairy and whey proteins, and ingredient premix solutions, all in nutrition

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, mass merchants, specialty nutrition and club stores; online: direct-to-consumer websites and e-commerce platforms; direct sales: ingredient and premix sales to food, beverage and supplement manufacturers; distributors / dealers: international distributors for brands and ingredients
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; online; direct sales; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, dietary supplement labeling and claims rules (FDA, EFSA, FSA), plus dairy and infant nutrition standards

notes: Portfolio details are from memory; the exact current segment split and any recently divested or restructured lines are uncertain.
